summary: docs/runbooks/openbao.md §3 now runs converge, restore, a second converge and verify. The new step 5 says why it is there, covers P1's three outcomes (a staged secret_id accepted, rejected, or none staged), and names the rotation run's cost. Step 3 notes the backup pipeline stays unconfigured, and step 6 adds a manual backup run. The root gate has no test statements and was skipped; a stale 'five role policies' count went to the close-out as B7.
